# TraceX

> > TraceX is a blockchain-powered supply chain traceability and compliance platform enabling end-to-end visibility, sustainability reporting, and regulatory adherence across agribusiness and carbon project sectors.

TraceX specializes in farm-to-fork traceability, EUDR compliance, ESG reporting, and digital MRV solutions for sustainable supply chains. The platform serves agribusinesses, processors, exporters, importers, carbon project developers, and sustainability consultants with integrated blockchain technology, geolocation verification, and comprehensive compliance tools.

## Key Topics

- EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation)
- Supply Chain Traceability
- Blockchain Technology
- Digital MRV (Monitoring, Reporting & Verification)
- Food Safety & Traceability
- ESG Reporting
- DDS (Due Diligence Statement)
- Geolocation Verification
- Sustainability Compliance
- Farm-to-Fork Transparency
- Supplier Onboarding
- Carbon Credits & Net-Zero
- GIS & GPS Integration
- Regulatory Compliance
- Deforestation Risk Assessment

## Core Solutions

- [EUDR Compliance Solution](https://tracextech.com/eudr-compliance-solution): AI-powered EUDR solution with DDS generation and deforestation tracking for regulatory compliance
- [Food Traceability Solution](https://tracextech.com/food-traceability-solution): Farm-to-fork food traceability with FSSC, FSMA, and BRC compliance standards
- [Supply Chain Sustainability Solution](https://tracextech.com/supply-chain-sustainability-solution): ESG reporting platform for SDG compliance, ethical sourcing, and sustainability management
- [Digital MRV Solution](https://tracextech.com/digital-mrv-solution): Streamlined sustainability reporting for carbon credits, climate impact tracking, and net-zero initiatives
- [Farm Management Solution](https://tracextech.com/farm-management-solution): Farm traceability software for crop yields, sustainability metrics, and emissions tracking

## EUDR Compliance Solutions

- [EUDR Compliance for Importers](https://tracextech.com/eudr-compliance-software-landing-page): EUDR software for importers featuring risk assessment, supplier onboarding, and DDS management
- [EUDR Compliance for Exporters](https://tracextech.com/eudr-compliance-software-exporters-landing-page): EUDR software for exporters with farm-to-product traceability and deforestation risk detection
- [EUDR Compliance Platform](https://tracextech.com/eudr-compliance-platform): Blockchain-backed EUDR compliance platform for comprehensive deforestation analysis

## Industry Solutions

- [Agribusiness Solutions](https://tracextech.com/industry/agribusiness): Comprehensive agribusiness solutions including farm-to-fork traceability, EUDR compliance, and carbon reporting
- [Carbon Project Developer Solutions](https://tracextech.com/industry/carbon-project-developer): Digital MRV platform for carbon projects, net-zero commitments, and environmental compliance
- [Processor Solutions](https://tracextech.com/industry/processor): Traceability and EUDR compliance solutions tailored for food processors and manufacturers
- [Foundations Solutions](https://tracextech.com/industry/foundations): Platforms for foundations covering traceability, MRV, EUDR, and sustainability initiatives
- [Consultant Solutions](https://tracextech.com/industry/consultants): B2B solutions for consultants offering sustainability, MRV, and EUDR compliance platforms
